tasks.short: Reconcile each payroll run with Rabobank payments and prepare the payroll close report.

today.trigger: A regular or supplementary payroll run has settled and the period needs closing.
steps: Export the final payroll totals and payment batch details from AFAS.
Obtain the relevant Rabobank statements and payment statuses.
Match payroll payments, returns and outstanding amounts in Excel.
Investigate differences with Finance and correct their classification.
Prepare the reconciliation report and retain supporting records.
drudgery: Repeatedly downloading and formatting files.
Matching the same payment references across spreadsheets.
Rebuilding the close report for every run.
today.time_sinks: Tracing rejected payments, supplementary runs and settlement timing differences across separate exports.

lenses.faster: Approved exports feed a rules-based matcher and report template. Most copying, formatting and routine matching disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A settled payment batch triggers reconciliation; exact matches close automatically and differences enter an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Check every supplementary run promptly and track repeated payment failures by cause, reducing the time employees wait for missing wages.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet matching and leave the specialist to resolve discrepancies that matter to employees.
lenses.options: Show alternative explanations for unmatched amounts, such as a rejected transfer, a later settlement or a duplicate batch, with supporting records.
lenses.altitude: Own the matching rules, exception thresholds and reconciliation quality instead of assembling each report.
reach: Prepare payroll payment exception evidence for the Accountant.
Provide payment failure trends to the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.

tasks.human_edge: Judge ambiguous differences and coordinate urgent unpaid wages without treating a plausible match as proof.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: amounts, batch identifiers and settlement records support checkable matching rules. A model is unnecessary for routine reconciliation.

in_practice.trigger: An approved payroll batch reaches its expected settlement date and fresh bank records are available.
steps: Read the frozen AFAS payroll run and approved Rabobank statement export.
Validate totals, identifiers, file completeness and duplicate imports.
Match batches and individual transfers using available references and amounts.
Separate returns, outstanding transfers and unexplained differences.
Save the reconciliation report and assign exceptions to the responsible person.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist resolves ambiguous matches and approves period-close sign-off; the workflow cannot release or repeat payments.
systems: AFAS Profit approved export or connector
Rabobank approved statement and payment-status export
data_needed: Final payroll run identifier and net-pay totals
Payment batch identifiers and control totals
Bank transactions, settlement dates and available payment references
Rejected and returned payment statuses
Approved matching tolerances and exception owners
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted payroll reconciliation register in SharePoint, recording source versions, matches, exceptions and sign-off.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports payroll processing and payroll reporting.
Structured payroll and bank exports can be reconciled with deterministic rules when identifiers and settlement details are adequate.

risks: Matching on amount alone can hide duplicate or misdirected payments.
Incomplete bank records can make an unsettled batch appear reconciled.
Payroll and bank details require restricted access and controlled retention under AVG/GDPR.
Savings overlap with payroll account balancing unless the two workflows share one evidence set.
research_questions: Which Rabobank exports expose batch references, individual settlement statuses and rejected transfers?
What share of current matches is exact, and how many need judgment?
Can supplementary runs and duplicate imports be distinguished reliably using AFAS run identifiers?

tasks.short: Run payroll, check net pay, prepare the Rabobank payment batch and publish employees' payslips.

today.trigger: The monthly payroll cutoff or an approved supplementary payment run.
steps: Confirm that starters, leavers, hours and approved changes are complete in AFAS.
Calculate payroll and compare results with the previous run.
Investigate unusual net pay, deductions and missing inputs.
Prepare the payment batch and obtain the required approval.
Publish payslips through the approved employee channel and confirm payment status.
drudgery: Repeating completeness checks across several lists.
Manually comparing payroll runs.
Chasing missing approvals before cutoff.
today.time_sinks: Late changes and exception investigation; AFAS already performs the core payroll calculation.

lenses.faster: Automate input completeness checks, run comparisons and approval reminders around AFAS. The specialist reviews a concise exception list.
lenses.autonomous: The cutoff triggers validation and preparation of a draft run, payment file and release checklist; approval remains required.
lenses.ambitious: Detect missing shift allowances and starter details before cutoff, helping new hires receive correct pay in their first month.
lenses.joy: Remove checklist copying and repeated chasing, leaving time to explain and resolve unusual pay outcomes.
lenses.options: Compare paying an approved correction in a supplementary run with including it next month, showing employee impact and processing cost.
lenses.altitude: Design payroll release controls and improve first-time accuracy across all three sites.
reach: Give HR Administrators targeted feedback on incomplete payroll inputs.
Provide Finance with a verified payment approval pack.

tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for unusual pay outcomes and employee fairness; authorized Finance staff retain bank-release responsibility.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: coordinating inputs, calculations, exceptions and release requires several systems. Deterministic checks do the calculation work, with explicit approval before publication and payment.

in_practice.trigger: The payroll cutoff is reached and the authorized input window closes.
steps: Validate approved inputs against starters, leavers, contracts and applicable CAO rules.
Prepare the AFAS calculation through supported interfaces and compare it with prior runs.
Flag missing inputs, unusual movements and changed bank details.
Assemble the payroll approval pack and draft payment batch.
After recorded approvals, publish payslips and hand the batch to authorized bank signers.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves the final payroll and payslip release; a separate authorized person releases the Rabobank batch under the company's payment controls.
systems: AFAS employee payslip channel, if configured
data_needed: Approved contracts, hours, overtime and shift allowances
Applicable CAO, tax and pension configuration
Previous and current payroll results
Authorized bank-detail changes
Payroll calendar, approval matrix and payment limits
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS payroll run history and a restricted release register containing checks, approvals, batch totals and publication status.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit provides payroll calculation and payslip functionality.
Completeness checks and comparisons between payroll runs can be implemented as deterministic controls.

risks: A wrong CAO mapping can systematically miscalculate shift allowances or overtime.
Bank-detail changes require independent verification to prevent payment fraud.
Nightly Power BI data can be stale at release time; checks must use the final AFAS run.
Agency flex workers are normally paid by their agencies; their invoice settlement must stay separate from employee payroll.
research_questions: Which calculation, export and payslip-release actions are supported by Noordhaven's AFAS configuration?
How much time is spent checking and chasing compared with time already handled automatically?
Who approves payroll, verifies bank changes and signs Rabobank batches, including during absence?

tasks.short: Send HR and Finance reliable summaries of pay, deductions, employer costs and benefits.

today.trigger: Payroll closes or HR and Finance request a pay or benefits summary.
steps: Collect payroll and benefits totals from AFAS and the available Power BI extract.
Map records to sites, departments and cost centres.
Calculate totals and compare them with prior periods.
Prepare the requested spreadsheet or report and explain material movements.
Share it with authorized recipients and retain the report version.
drudgery: Recreating similar departmental spreadsheets.
Repairing inconsistent cost-centre mappings.
Copying totals into recurring emails.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling different report definitions and explaining changes without a clear record of payroll movements.

lenses.faster: Use agreed measures and reusable report templates. Repeated extraction, grouping and formatting largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A validated nightly refresh after payroll close updates the reports and distributes approved summaries to the right departments.
lenses.ambitious: Provide consistent employer-cost and allowance trends by site every month, with explanations linked to actual payroll changes.
lenses.joy: Replace spreadsheet rebuilding with useful conversations about costs and recurring payroll problems.
lenses.options: Offer approved views by site, department and pay component, and separate recurring costs from one-off corrections.
lenses.altitude: Own the definitions and quality of payroll reporting so HR and Finance work from the same numbers.
reach: Maintain payroll measures with the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Supply verified payroll cost bridges to the FP&A Analysts.

tasks.human_edge: Explain sensitive or misleading movements and decide which level of detail each audience needs.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: recurring measures and distribution rules can be specified and tested. Optional narrative drafts are an llm_step grounded only in validated aggregates.

in_practice.trigger: The nightly AFAS extract contains a finalized payroll period and passes freshness and completeness checks.
steps: Load the finalized period and apply versioned department and pay-component mappings.
Reconcile aggregate totals to the approved payroll close.
Calculate agreed measures and flag unexplained movements.
Generate audience-specific reports with appropriate access restrictions.
Distribute standard summaries and route unusual interpretations to the specialist.
in_practice.human_gate: Approve new measures, new audiences and sensitive commentary; established reports distribute automatically after validation.
data_needed: Final payroll results and employer contributions
Versioned cost-centre and site mappings
Agreed metric definitions
Approved comparison periods and materiality thresholds
Recipient permissions and small-group disclosure rules
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted reporting register recording refresh time, source period, reconciliation results, report version and recipients.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports reusable measures, scheduled refresh and report subscriptions, subject to configuration and licensing.
Versioned measures and reconciled totals can replace repeated spreadsheet preparation.

risks: A successful refresh can still contain an unfinished payroll period.
Small site or department groups can reveal individual pay through aggregates.
Generated explanations may confuse correlation with cause unless linked to approved changes.
If reporting expands into employee monitoring or employment decisions, assess OR requirements and applicable EU AI Act obligations before use.
research_questions: Which recurring reports consume time despite the existing Power BI dashboards?
Do HR and Finance agree on employer-cost definitions and treatment of retroactive corrections?
Can access controls and small-group suppression prevent disclosure of individual pay?
Does current Power BI licensing support the proposed refresh and distribution setup?

tasks.short: Reconcile payroll clearing accounts and explain outstanding payroll-related cash balances to Finance.

today.trigger: Payroll journals are posted or Finance starts the monthly close.
steps: Extract payroll journals and related general-ledger account balances from AFAS.
Reuse the payroll-to-bank reconciliation evidence.
Match payroll liabilities and clearing entries to payments and subsequent settlements.
Investigate old balances, missing postings and incorrect account mappings.
Agree corrections and close status with the Accountant or Controller.
drudgery: Repeating matches already performed for payroll payment reconciliation.
Carrying forward spreadsheets of unresolved balances.
Manually checking whether prior-period items have cleared.
today.time_sinks: Tracing old balances between payroll runs, journal entries and cash settlements.

lenses.faster: Reuse payment matches and automate roll-forward schedules for payroll-related accounts. Only unexplained balances need investigation.
lenses.autonomous: New journals or bank settlements refresh account reconciliations and flag overdue open items.
lenses.ambitious: Track each unresolved payroll balance by owner and age throughout the month, reducing surprises at Finance close.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated ledger ticking and focus on understanding why balances persist.
lenses.options: Present evidence for a timing difference, missing posting or mapping error and show the proposed accounting treatment.
lenses.altitude: Manage the payroll accounting control framework and improve the interface between payroll and Finance.
reach: Prepare payroll account reconciliation schedules for the Accountant.
Provide the Controller with aged payroll liabilities and close exceptions.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous accounting treatment with Finance and recognize when a tidy reconciliation hides an underlying payroll problem.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: ledger movements, payment matches and balance roll-forwards are structured and checkable. Accounting corrections remain subject to Finance approval.

in_practice.trigger: A payroll journal posts, a related payment settles or the monthly close starts.
steps: Read payroll-related ledger movements and the shared payment reconciliation register.
Validate opening balances and payroll journal control totals.
Match liability and clearing movements using approved account-specific rules.
Produce closing balances, aged open items and proposed corrections.
Route unresolved items to their owners and save the close evidence.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant or Controller approves accounting corrections and Finance close sign-off; the specialist approves payroll explanations.
systems: AFAS Profit payroll and general ledger
data_needed: Payroll journals and ledger entries
Opening balances and previous close sign-off
Shared payroll-to-bank matching results
Account mappings and expected settlement dates
Finance materiality rules and correction authority
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted payroll account close register with balance roll-forwards, matching references, open-item owners and approved corrections.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit includes payroll and financial administration functionality.
Account-specific matching and balance roll-forwards can be automated from structured ledger records.

risks: Incorrect account mappings can clear the wrong liability while leaving the real issue unresolved.
Automatic write-offs or journals could conceal errors; corrections require Finance approval.
Payroll should cover payroll-related accounts only; Finance retains responsibility for the wider cash ledger.
Shared reconciliation work must be counted once when estimating combined savings.
research_questions: Which payroll accounts does the specialist reconcile, and which belong entirely to Finance?
How much work duplicates payroll-to-bank matching?
What proportion of open items follows predictable settlement rules, and what proportion requires accounting judgment?

tasks.short: Calculate and record payroll corrections and backdated CAO increases, then explain the effect on employees' pay.

today.trigger: An approved pay error, contract change or retroactive CAO increase requires correction.
steps: Gather the approved change, effective date and affected employee records.
Check the applicable CAO and pay components for each affected period.
Calculate the correction in AFAS and compare it with the original results.
Check tax, pension and net-pay effects and obtain approval.
Process the correction and provide a clear explanation where needed.
drudgery: Finding every affected employee and historical period.
Comparing old and corrected payroll results manually.
Rewriting similar correction explanations.
today.time_sinks: Determining historical entitlement across changing contracts, allowances, CAO versions and pension treatment.

lenses.faster: Build the affected population and before-and-after comparison automatically, while AFAS performs the payroll recalculation.
lenses.autonomous: An approved change triggers a draft correction pack with affected periods, amounts and exceptions, ready for specialist approval.
lenses.ambitious: Check every affected employee after a CAO change and confirm that all approved increases reached payroll correctly.
lenses.joy: Remove historical spreadsheet reconstruction and preserve the work of resolving difficult entitlement questions fairly.
lenses.options: Compare an approved supplementary run with the next regular run, showing timing and net-pay effects without changing the underlying entitlement.
lenses.altitude: Own correction rules, effective-date controls and root-cause prevention.
reach: Validate pay-change implementation with the Compensation and Benefits Specialist.
Give HR Administrators feedback on errors causing repeated corrections.

tasks.human_edge: Interpret disputed entitlement and explain unexpected deductions or repayments with care; employees need an accountable person.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: identifying affected records, historical recalculation and approval spans multiple steps. Any llm_step extracts draft change details with source references; AFAS and explicit rules calculate money.

in_practice.trigger: An authorized correction request or approved CAO pay change is recorded with an effective date.
steps: Capture the approved change and link its source, scope and effective date.
Identify affected employees and historical payroll periods.
Prepare AFAS recalculations using approved, versioned parameters.
Compare original and corrected gross pay, net pay, tax and pension amounts.
Obtain approval, process the correction and retain the employee explanation.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves the affected population, rule interpretation and final correction; disputed recovery of overpayments follows HR and legal review.
systems: Outlook or approved employee communication channel
data_needed: Approved correction request or CAO amendment
Historical contracts, pay scales and CAO assignment
Original payroll results and affected pay components
Historical tax and pension parameters
Correction approval and employee communication requirements
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS correction history and a restricted change register linking the source, calculation comparison, approval and affected payroll runs.

evidence.claim: Payroll correction preparation can use effective-date rules and comparisons of original and recalculated results.
An LLM can draft structured change details from a CAO document, but extraction requires validation against the source.

risks: A wrong effective date or CAO population can produce a large batch of incorrect corrections.
Historical tax and pension treatment may differ from current parameters.
Overpayment recovery can have legal and employee-relations consequences and must not be automatic.
Repeated execution can duplicate corrections unless each approved change has a unique processing identifier.
research_questions: How does the current AFAS configuration handle historical recalculation and prior-year corrections?
Can approved changes identify the correct CAO population and effective date without manual reconstruction?
Which correction types consume most time, and how often are entitlement or recovery terms disputed?

tasks.short: Prepare, check and submit the Dutch payroll tax return, then confirm acceptance and arrange payment with Finance.

today.trigger: The payroll tax reporting period closes or a correction to a previous return is required.
steps: Finalize the relevant payroll runs in AFAS.
Generate the loonaangifte and reconcile its totals with payroll and the ledger.
Investigate validation errors and determine required corrections.
Submit the approved return through the supported channel.
Confirm acceptance and give Finance the payment amount, reference and deadline.
drudgery: Repeating deadline and submission-status checks.
Copying declaration totals into control sheets.
Reassembling the same filing evidence.
today.time_sinks: Resolving employee-level validation errors and reconciling supplementary runs or earlier-period corrections.

lenses.faster: Automate reconciliation, validation summaries and evidence collection around the existing AFAS declaration process.
lenses.autonomous: The reporting calendar triggers draft preparation and deadline alerts; submission follows explicit approval and acceptance is checked automatically.
lenses.ambitious: Track filing, acceptance and payment obligations together so rejected returns and missed deadlines surface promptly.
lenses.joy: Remove calendar chasing and control-sheet copying, leaving the specialist to resolve unusual tax questions.
lenses.options: Where Dutch filing rules permit alternatives, prepare supported correction routes with deadlines and amounts for specialist review.
lenses.altitude: Own the payroll tax control calendar, validation rules and evidence quality.
reach: Provide the Accountant with reconciled payroll tax liabilities.
Supply Finance with verified payment instructions and acceptance evidence.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve uncertain tax treatment and remain accountable for filing accuracy; software acceptance alone does not prove legal correctness.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: preparation, reconciliation, submission and acceptance monitoring form a multi-step workflow. AFAS and deterministic controls produce the return; a person approves each filing.

in_practice.trigger: The filing calendar identifies a due period and its payroll runs are finalized.
steps: Generate the draft loonaangifte through AFAS's supported process.
Reconcile declaration totals to finalized payroll and related ledger balances.
Check validation messages, previous filings and required corrections.
Present the return, reconciliation and deadline for specialist approval.
Submit after approval, retain acceptance evidence and notify Finance of the payment obligation.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves each original or corrective filing; authorized Finance staff approve and release the tax payment separately.
data_needed: Payroll tax number and reporting calendar
Final payroll results and declaration control totals
Previous filings and correction history
Current validation rules and submission responses
Payment reference, amount and deadline
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted tax filing register containing return version, reconciliation, approval, submission timestamp, acceptance response and payment handoff.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports Dutch payroll tax declaration functionality.
Deadline controls, total reconciliation and submission-status monitoring can be automated around a payroll tax process.

risks: A technically accepted return may still contain incorrect tax treatment.
Submission failure or duplicate filing can be missed without explicit response tracking.
Current-year and prior-year corrections may require different handling.
Existing AFAS automation limits the additional time available to save.
research_questions: Which preparation, submission and acceptance checks does AFAS already automate here?
Can submission responses and rejection details be retrieved reliably through supported interfaces?
How often do corrections or unusual tax treatments require external advice?

tasks.short: Check pension and benefit records and submit payroll-related changes to the relevant providers.

today.trigger: A starter, leaver, contract change or reporting deadline affects pension or another applicable benefit.
steps: Gather approved employee changes and identify the applicable scheme.
Check eligibility, effective dates, pensionable pay and required fields.
Prepare the provider's file or form and compare contributions with payroll.
Submit through the approved channel and investigate rejected records.
Record acceptance and pass unresolved eligibility questions to Compensation and Benefits.
systems: Applicable pension and benefit provider portals
drudgery: Re-entering employee details in provider forms.
Checking similar eligibility and completeness conditions repeatedly.
Chasing rejected records and submission confirmations.
today.time_sinks: Differences between provider requirements, historical corrections and incomplete employee records.

lenses.faster: Populate provider files from approved AFAS records and validate required fields before submission.
lenses.autonomous: Approved employee changes trigger draft provider updates; missing information and disputed eligibility enter an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Confirm timely pension enrolment and contribution accuracy for every eligible starter and reconcile provider acceptance with payroll.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated form filling and let the specialist resolve cases where benefit coverage or deductions could be wrong.
lenses.options: For a rejected record, present supported correction paths based on provider rules and the employee's approved history.
lenses.altitude: Maintain scheme mappings, provider interfaces and end-to-end coverage controls.
reach: Take on routine pension administration from the Compensation and Benefits Specialist.
Check benefit-related starter and leaver completeness with HR Administrators.

tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous eligibility with the scheme owner and explain sensitive coverage or deduction issues to employees.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: scheme selection, file preparation, submission and rejection handling span several systems. Deterministic rules validate records; any document extraction is a checked llm_step.

in_practice.trigger: An approved AFAS employee change affects a configured scheme, or a provider reporting period closes.
steps: Identify the applicable scheme from approved employment and CAO records.
Validate eligibility, effective dates, pensionable pay and mandatory fields.
Generate the provider file or draft form and reconcile contributions to payroll.
Obtain approval and submit through the provider's supported route.
Record acceptance, resolve rejected records and check that intended changes took effect.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves each submission batch; Compensation and Benefits resolves scheme interpretation and disputed eligibility.
systems: AFAS Profit approved export or connector
Configured pension and benefit provider interfaces
Restricted SharePoint scheme and submission register
data_needed: Approved starter, leaver and contract changes
Applicable scheme rules and CAO assignment
Pensionable pay and contribution parameters
Provider identifiers, file specifications and reporting deadlines
Submission responses and prior accepted records
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted provider submission register linking employee changes, scheme versions, control totals, approvals, acceptance and outstanding exceptions.

evidence.claim: Provider files and benefit forms can be populated and checked from structured employment and payroll records.
Dutch statutory employee insurance is largely handled through payroll; this task should focus on actual pension, benefit and any separate statutory reporting obligations.

risks: The two CAOs may require different pension or benefit treatment; applicable schemes must be confirmed.
Agency workers generally belong to their agency's payroll and benefit administration, so scope must be explicit.
Payroll should receive only necessary absence and entitlement information, not medical diagnoses or occupational-health records under Wet verbetering poortwachter.
Provider acceptance does not establish that eligibility or pensionable pay was correct.
research_questions: Which pension and benefit schemes actually apply to each CAO and employee population?
Which providers accept supported files or integrations, and which require manual portal entry?
How many rejected records arise from missing data versus ambiguous scheme rules?
Which submissions already run automatically in AFAS, and which separate statutory forms remain?

role.altitude: Become the owner of payroll accuracy and controls across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo: maintain rules, monitor exceptions and improve the inputs that determine correct pay.
reach: Prepare payroll account reconciliations and close evidence for the Accountant and Controller.
Provide verified payroll cost movements to FP&A and the People Analytics and HRIS Analyst.
Handle routine pension submission preparation for Compensation and Benefits.
Help HR Administrators prevent recurring starter, leaver and contract-change errors.
role.ceiling_note: The seven tasks cover 482.8 hours annually, about 30% of the role. The estimates imply roughly 176 hours and EUR 9,700 of annual capacity before overlapping work, implementation and support costs; this is not a headcount saving. Current workflows and gains are hypotheses to validate. Existing AFAS automation, late inputs, CAO interpretation and required approvals limit further savings. Speedups estimate processing time after inputs are available; external settlement and response waits remain.
skills_to_grow: Translate CAO and payroll policies into versioned, testable rules.
Configure AFAS workflows and evaluate supported exports and connectors.
Design reconciliations, duplicate prevention and exception handling.
Define consistent payroll measures with Finance and HR analytics.
Manage AVG/GDPR access, retention and traceable approvals.
Explain corrections and sensitive pay outcomes clearly.
Assess OR involvement for changes to employee-data processing or monitoring, and EU AI Act obligations if AI expands into employment decisions.
role.ambitious_version: Run a payroll control system that catches missing starter details, shift allowances, pension changes and payment failures early. Measure first-time pay accuracy, unresolved exceptions and payroll problems in a new hire's first 90 days, linking reliable pay to Noordhaven's productive-and-retained hiring goal. Automate repeatable checks while keeping accountable payroll approval, employee support and separate bank authorization.
